fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (40.952909, -75.974562) landed in downtown Hazleton, ~3km off the real plant. The actual facility is at 2 Chestnut Hill Drive in the Humboldt Industrial Park, Hazle Township (40.9275, -76.0652) - confirmed via web search; a Google Maps directions URL embedded the precise coords. The plant is a bread/bakery products facility.
fieldNotes.ownership: Roster sourced this from the Hyster GM plant list. The Hazleton plant was part of GM's frozen-dough/bakeries business that was divested (Pennant Foods, later Fresh Start Bakeries / Aspire Bakeries). Web directories list both 'General Mills' and 'Fresh Start Bakeries North America' at 2 Chestnut Hill Dr. The physical building audited is the correct site for the roster entry.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck access road runs off Chestnut Hill Drive into the trailer yard as an open paved driveway. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point visible in z19-z21 satellite imagery at the property line - classified false. No Street View coverage exists inside the industrial park to confirm, so flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth or staffed structure visible at or near the property entrance in satellite imagery. false (uncertain - no Street View).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large open paved yard between the entrance and the dock aprons gives ample internal holding room; the gate-to-dock approach is long (drivewayLong=true).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors on the building's W and N faces with trailers backed in (z18 imagery shows ~6-10 doors per face); total estimated 10-25 band. Exact count uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yard on the NW with ~15-25 trailers parked in rows; dropYard=true.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; the nearest rail is well off-site.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Humboldt Industrial Park, Hazle Township - an edge-of-town industrial park surrounded by woods/open land, ~1 mile from I-81. Classified Rural per the small-town-industrial tie-break rule.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Industrial park near I-81 with neighboring large facilities (Amazon, US Cold Storage, Niagara) - cellular coverage likely adequate; false at low confidence.
